question: A train travelling at a speed of 45 km/h crosses a pole in 24 sec. What is the length of the train?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the train = 45 km/h

Time to cross the pole = 24 sec

**Formula Used:**

Length of the train = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Convert speed from km/h to m/s:

Speed = 45 km/h × (1000 m / 1 km) × (1 h / 3600 sec)

Speed = 45 × (1000 / 3600)

Speed = 45 × (5 / 18)

Speed = 12.5 m/s

Time = 24 sec

Length of the train = Speed × Time

⇒ Length = 12.5 m/s × 24 sec

⇒ Length = 300 m

**The length of the train is 300 m.**
